note: Third-party libraries of the engine. Versions follow from the vcpkg commit pinned in .github/workflows/engine.yml. engine/tools/vuln_check.py reads each version from that vcpkg checkout, resolves the upstream release tag to a commit, and asks the OSV database about that commit on every push. 'expected_version' and 'expected_commit' were recorded from CI run 45086860497 (2026-11-23) and are enforced: a different value fails the check.

openssl.used_for: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 of file bytes

nlohmann-json.used_for: JSON of results and of channel messages (messages come from the same user, not from scanned files)

yara.used_for: rule matching over file bytes; pinned to the reference's version 4.5.1 (reviewer's condition M-5)

zlib.used_for: raw deflate of zip members and of gzip-compressed tars (reviewer's ruling M-4c)

bzip2.used_for: bzip2 zip members and bzip2-compressed tars (reviewer's ruling M-4c)

liblzma.used_for: lzma zip members and xz/lzma-compressed tars (reviewer's ruling M-4c)

accepted_vulnerabilities.reason: Not reachable: the flaw is in loading compiled-rules files, which the engine never does. The engine's calls into YARA are: yr_initialize, yr_compiler_create, yr_compiler_set_callback, yr_compiler_set_include_callback, yr_compiler_add_string, yr_compiler_get_rules, yr_compiler_destroy, yr_rule_metas_foreach, yr_rules_scan_mem, yr_rules_destroy.
conditions: the guard against yr_rules_load, yr_rules_load_stream, yr_rules_save and yr_rules_save_stream stays for good
this record only: any other advisory fails the check
rules enter only as the shipped source files; a rule 'include' is not followed; the shipped rule folder is not writable by an ordinary user after install (shown in the install test)
re-check at each release candidate; a move to a fixed YARA release that still passes rules parity is a numbered difference

vulnerability_guards.what: An assertion can be reached when LOADING a crafted compiled-rules file (.yrc); the program then terminates. Public record: https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2026-88341 (CVSS 3.1 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H). The record names YARA 4.5.8, the newest release, as affected; the fix it points to is in a fork, not in a YARA release.
vulnerability_guards.why_guarded: The engine never loads compiled-rules files: rules are compiled at start from the rule source files shipped with the product, and the bytes of a scanned file never reach the rule loader.
vulnerability_guards.status: ACCEPTED AS NOT REACHABLE by r-01, board B-3616, 2026-11-23; the guard stays for good.
